supersedes.reason: v5 review failed because reviewed_commit was not resolved and hashed project modules were imported before digest verification

bootstrap.required_launch_sequence: From the clean Git checkout root on A: sha256sum -c data/manifests/bootstrap_blind_unseal_v6.py.sha256, and only on PASS run python3 src/data/bootstrap_blind_unseal_v6.py --bundle-root .
bootstrap.required_git_state: A complete clean Git checkout whose HEAD contains the PASS review receipt and descends from reviewed_commit; every reviewed artifact and contract blob at reviewed_commit must match its frozen digest.
bootstrap.pre_import_rule: The stdlib-only bootstrap verifies its externally checked digest, every reviewed artifact, the PASS receipt, resolved reviewed commit, commit ancestry and committed blob digests before dynamically importing any project module.

review_gate.required_commit_rule: reviewed_commit must resolve as a commit in the deployed checkout, be an ancestor of HEAD, and contain byte-exact reviewed artifact and contract blobs

one_shot_protocol.executed_stage_reference_definition: Every HF/HMF stage-mode reference in the three formal search stages except contract-defined NOT_RUN; MISSING_RESULT_PATH remains in the denominator and fails R07.
one_shot_protocol.source_set_rule: After durable CONSUMED and before parsing, exact measurement and driver-log digests and counts must match the preregistered v6 job.
one_shot_protocol.consumer_rule: Reject unless all four canonical non-symlink artifacts exist and CONSUMED, receipt schema and allowed fields, sidecar digest, RELEASED receipt digest and both contract/tool bindings are exact.
one_shot_protocol.crash_rule: Any state after CONSUMED without a semantically verified RELEASED is INCOMPLETE_CONSUMED and cannot be replayed.

decision_rules.R06: PASS only with zero ambiguity for all three circuits.
decision_rules.R07: PASS only with zero missing and ambiguity, unique equal denominator and coverage 1.0 for all three circuits.
decision_rules.R13: After reseal bind every preregistered method to the same frozen per-circuit action hashes.
